'''Voyager''' is the 26th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 23 May 2001. The set consists of 218 cards.

This set is available in 11-card booster packs. There are 30 booster packs in one booster box. Also available are 40 card starter decks with 12 starter decks per box. Each starter box includes a 44 page Rules and Card List booklet.

'''Voyager''' takes you to the Delta Quadrant for new dimensions of gameplay. 201 cards include the U.S.S. Voyager and its crew, new Kazon and Vidiian affiliations, dual-affiliation cards with different border colors highlighting the different affiliations, dozens of new missions and dilemmas, 30 selected commons and uncommons from other sets updated with all-new Voyager images and lore, and much more. Fully compatible with all existing Star Trek CCG cards, '''Voyager''' also supports a Voyager stand-alone environment and both sealed deck and constructed deck Voyager Warp Speed formats.

Due to printing methods at the time, the Ultra-Rare Pendari Champion could be found in a Starter Deck in place of one of the Rares.

This set is noted for the following:
*Introduced Dual-Affiliation cards
*Contained thirty common and uncommon cards that were seen in earlier expansions updated with a Voyager theme and logo
*Introduced both the Kazon and Vidiian affiliations
*Introduced alternate images for Dual-Affiliation cards recognized by a '''*''' next to the card number
*20 cards were only found in the Starter Decks, identified by '''S''' in place of the card rarity
*17 Starter cards are reprints (and updates) from previous expansions
